title: REXzyme generates formate dehydrogenases from chemical reactions
summary: REXzyme is a translation model that generates enzymes conditioned on a user-defined chemical reaction. Steered toward formate dehydrogenases for CO2 reduction, all 20 generated enzymes were expressed as soluble proteins and showed CO2-reduction activity, the best at 2.5-fold the specific activity of the reference enzyme. All substitutions were at positions distal to the catalytic site. Only the abstract was reviewed, and the test covers a single enzyme family.
ai_technology: REXzyme reaction-to-sequence translation model for conditional enzyme generation
organization: Universitat Pompeu Fabra; Barcelona Institute of Science and Technology; Centre for Genomic Regulation

evidence.tested: Expression and specific-activity measurements of 20 generated formate dehydrogenases.
evidence.unknown: Generalization to other reactions beyond in silico metrics; full text not reviewed.
